snippet.title: TEKKEN TAG TOURNAMENT 2 Unlimited Arcade Trailer
snippet.description: TEKKEN TAG is back and better than ever with TEKKEN TAG TOURNAMENT 2 Unlimited. The sequel to the smash hit improves upon the original game's tag mechanics with seamless tag combinations as well as four-player tag battles. TTT2 Unlimited features technique modifications for characters to create more balanced and exciting battles. No partner? No problem! Use your favorite character and test your skills against two opponents in the 1 vs 2 game mode. Players can also fight solo in the 1 vs 1 game mode. Pair Play machines bring the tag battle to life with up to four players tagging and fighting it out for victory.
